newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV AND CROATIAN CHAMPIONS CLASH IN EUROPEAN CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-YUGOSLAV AND CROATIAN CHAMPIONS CLASH IN EUROPEAN CUP.

text.p: Partizan Belgrade of Yugoslavia will face Croatia Zagreb in the first qualifying round of the European Cup later this month in a match charged with social and political overtones.

The draw made on Wednesday brought the two old rivals together for their first meeting since the end of hostilities which led to the break-up of Yugoslavia in the bitter war of the early 1990s. They last met in the old Yugoslav first division in May 1991.
Partizan general secretary Zarko Zecevich tried to play down the significance of the meeting immediately after the draw.

"From a sporting standpoint it's a difficult match. It's just a football match for me but others will see it differently. But we will just approach this as another football game and let others worry about other things."
Vlatko Markovich, Croatia Zagreb's coach, said: "It is the most important match in the draw. We think we are the better side and there is nothing else to add."
When Croatia was established as an independent nation, the Croatian team changed their name from Dynamo Zagreb to Croatia Zagreb.

They had a long rivalry with Partizan Belgrade, who won the Yugoslav title 14 times to Zagreb's four. Belgrade were also more successful in the Yugoslav Cup, winning that trophy five times compared with Croatia's four, but Zagreb were triumphant in their only Cup Final clash, winning 3-2 in 1960.
The winners will face Newcastle United of England in the preliminary round in August. The winner of that tie will go into the expanded Champions League.

Another clash of old footballing adversaries brings together 1986 European champions Steaua Bucharest of Romania and CSKA Sofia of Bulgaria. The winners meet Paris St Germain, runners-up in the European Cup Winners' Cup to Barcelona last season, in the preliminary round.

Scottish champions Rangers, who have spent some 6.0 million pounds ($10 million) this summer in a bid to succeed in Europe after years of relative failure, start in the qualifying round with a flight north to the Faroe Islands where they play GI Gotu.
Rangers should win easily but then face difficult opponents IFK Gothenburg in the preliminary round.
The draws were made for both the qualifying and preliminary rounds of the European Cup. The eight clubs seeded in the Champions League were not involved but every other team was.

Barcelona, the 1992 European champions, should have no trouble in reaching the Champions League after being drawn to play the winners of the qualifying round tie between Latvians Skonto Riga and Valletta of Malta.
Dutch club Feyenoord, who won the European Cup in 1970, should also prove far too strong for either Lantana of Estonia or Jazz Pori of Finland.

Germans Bayer Leverkusen, who together with European champions Borussia Dortmund and Bundesliga champions Bayern Munich make up a trio of German clubs in the competition, face either part-timers Crusaders of Northern Ireland or Dynamo Tblisi in the preliminary round.

In the UEFA Cup, Celtic, who have warmed up on a pre-season tour of the Netherlands with victories of 21-0 and 8-0 in the last few days, take on the amateurs of Inter CableTel Cardiff in the preliminary round of that competition.

And fellow Scots Dundee United provide the first-ever opposition for an Andorran team in Europe, having been drawn to face CE Principat -- whose real name is Real Madrid Supporters Club of Charlie's Restaurant.

Crvena Zvezda (Red Star) Belgrade, European champions six years ago, play HJK Helsinki in the qualifying round of the European Cup Winners' Cup which will have a new winner this season as holders Barcelona are in the European Cup.

Matches in the qualifying round of the European Cup and preliminary round of the UEFA Cup will take place on July 23 and 30. Preliminary round matches in the European Cup will be on August 13 and August 27 and qualifying round matches in the European Cup Winners' Cup will be on August 14 and August 28.
